production.note: US model years. First: Subaru's press kit introduces the 'all-new 2022 WRX' and says "The 2022 WRX will be available at Subaru retailers in early 2022". Still on sale: Subaru of America's consumer site showed the "2026 WRX" from $32,495 on 2026-10-01 (subaru-us-wrx-current).

aspiration.note: 'turbocharged with intercooler'; the press kit describes 'a turbocharger' (single).

drivetrain.note: Manual: 'Continuous All-Wheel Drive with viscous-coupling locking center differential'; automatic: 'Variable Torque Distribution (VTD) with planetary gear-type center differential'.

transmission.note: 'Standard: 6-speed manual'; 'Standard for GT and optional for others: Subaru Performance Transmission A/T (SPT) with 8-speed manual shifting modes'. Subaru's pages do not describe the SPT's construction; Autoblog's first drive (autoblog-2022-wrx-first-drive, Byron Hurd) calls it 'a tarred-up CVT by another ... name'.

powerHp.note: Quote: "Horsepower 271 hp @ 5,600 rpm". Press kit (subaru-us-2022-wrx-press-kit): "delivering 271 horsepower at 5,600 rpm". Subaru's consumer site still quotes 271 hp for the 2026 model (subaru-us-wrx-current).

weightLb.note: Base trim, 6-speed manual, 2022 model. Quote: "Base curb weight (lbs.) 6-speed manual transmission ... WRX Base: 3,297". With the SPT the Base is 3,431 lb; the GT (SPT only) is 3,534 lb. Subaru's 2022 trim comparison (subaru-us-2022-wrx-trim-comparison) gives the same: 'Base curb weight (manual/automatic): 3,297 lbs. / 3,431 lbs.'
